description: Returns the cmbs.news distress index: monthly delinquency, special-servicing and matured-unpaid rates since December 2016 (balance-weighted, every public trust), current rates by property type, vintage, type by vintage and state, and this month's transfers in and out of special servicing. Open data under CC BY 4.0. Use it for market-wide rates and trends; use wire for the individual loans that changed this month. The result is large, about 8,000 tokens.
name: distress_index
title: CMBS distress index
